<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The booking has been successfully created. Now I need to inform Brad so he can complete the final step, which is sending the confirmation email. I will post a message to the workspace.

function.arguments: {"text":"Great news, Brad. I've gone ahead and booked the meeting for Tuesday, November 17 at 9:00 AM. The booking is in the system.\n\nIt's now over to you to send the confirmation email to all the partners. Thanks for your help in getting this sorted out!"}
